## Fix the blank Files editor in installed builds

Nova Desktop 0.10.1 fixes the Files view showing line numbers and fold controls without visible source code in the installed app.

### Fixed

- CodeMirror now uses Tauri's per-page style nonce. The packaged Content Security Policy previously refused the editor's generated stylesheet, stacking its gutters above the source text and pushing code outside the visible editor. Syntax highlighting and editor layout now receive the same authorization as the app's other styles; CSP remains enforced.
- After following a relative Markdown link and returning to the file tree through a breadcrumb, reopening the active tab now opens the selected file instead of the original linked-from file.
- The startup curtain now displays the Nova badge consistently with the app's branding and respects reduced motion.

### Validation

- Added a packaged-app Files check (`node scripts/verify-tools.mjs --packaged-files`) that requires the embedded frontend, observes CSP violations, and checks visible source, editor columns, syntax highlighting, CRLF saves, conflicts, draft recovery and relative-link/breadcrumb/tab navigation.
- The new checks reproduce the failures in v0.10.0. Development-server-only checks could not detect the stylesheet refusal because they do not exercise the packaged CSP.

### Installation

Windows x64 MSI and NSIS installers and the signed updater manifest are attached. Existing users can update through Settings → About after publication.

Thinking support, tool activity and the Files features introduced in v0.10.0 remain available. File previews retain the existing size and codec limits.
